verdicts.title: The Pseudo-Hyperbolic Functions and the Matrix Representation of Eisenstein Complex Numbers
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We consider the matrix representation of the Eisenstein numbers and in this context we discuss the theory of the Pseudo Hyperbolic Functions. We develop a geometrical interpretation and show the usefulness of the method in Physical problems related to the anomalous scattering of light by crystals

verdicts.title: Boolean Differential Operators
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We consider four combinatorial interpretations for the algebra of Boolean differential operators. We show that each interpretation yields an explicit matrix representation for Boolean differential operators.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract discusses matrix representations for Boolean differential operators via combinatorial interpretations, with no mention of Frobenius-Schur indicators or communication complexity lower bounds.

verdicts.title: A new Boolean matrix representation for Catalan semirings
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We construct a faithful representation of the semiring of all order-preserving decreasing transformations of a chain with $n+1$ elements by Boolean upper triangular $n\times n$-matrices.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract describes a faithful Boolean matrix representation of a semiring of order-preserving transformations, with no mention of Frobenius-Schur indicators or communication complexity. It shares only loose vocabulary ('matrix representation') with the conjecture.
